name: Ashutosh Gowariker

films.title: Jodhaa Akbar
films.overview: A sixteenth century love story about a marriage of alliance that gave birth to true love between a Mughal emperor and a Rajput princess.

films.title: Swades
films.overview: A successful Indian scientist returns home to his village to take his nanny back to America with him, and in the process rediscovers his roots.

films.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
films.overview: The year is 1893 and India is under British occupation. In a small village, the tyrannical Captain Russell has imposed an unprecedented land tax on its citizens. Outraged, Bhuvan, a rebellious farmer, rallies the villagers to publicly oppose the tax. Russell offers a novel way to settle the dispute: he challenges Bhuvan and his men to a game of cricket, a sport completely foreign to India. If Bhuvan and his men can defeat Russell's team, the tax will be repealed.

films.title: Mohenjo Daro
films.overview: During the Indus valley civilization, an Indigo farmer strives for the justice and protection of the city of Mohenjo-Daro and its civilians from an evil politician.
